ld.yes_telegram_has_no_fc78: Yes. Telegram has no app for televisions, but TMPlayer runs on Android TV and Google TV with Android 6.0 or above: a Chromecast with Google TV, a Mi TV Stick, an NVIDIA Shield or a television with Android TV built in. Install it with the free Downloader app by typing tmplayer.org/apk, open it and scan the QR code with Telegram on your phone. Your chats and channels appear with their videos as tiles, and a video starts within seconds while it keeps downloading. It is a player for the videos in your chats, so messages stay on your phone.
ld.is_there_a_telegram_fcd2: Is there a Telegram app for Fire TV Stick?
ld.not_from_telegram_amazon_2b83: Not from Telegram: Amazon's store has no Telegram app for Fire TV. TMPlayer plays the videos in your Telegram chats on a Fire TV Stick, Fire TV Cube or Fire TV Edition television with Fire OS 6 or newer. It is installed with the free Downloader app and the remote: turn on Developer options, let Downloader install apps, type tmplayer.org/apk into it and install. Then open TMPlayer and scan its QR code with Telegram on your phone. It is tested on a stick with 1 GB of RAM, and it offers its own updates, so Downloader is only needed once.
ld.how_do_i_play_8108: How do I play Telegram videos on a PC or Mac?
ld.install_tmplayer_on_windows_c4ff: Install TMPlayer on Windows 10 or 11, on 64-bit Linux or, as a preview, on a Mac with Apple Silicon running macOS 26 or newer. On Windows, one line in PowerShell installs it, or use the MSI installer; on Linux, take the AppImage; on a Mac, open the DMG and drag TMPlayer into Applications. Sign in by scanning the QR code with Telegram on your phone, or with your phone number. Videos play through mpv while they download, with their subtitles, every audio track and keyboard shortcuts.
ld.is_tmplayer_free_is_76f2: Is TMPlayer free? Is there a paid version?
ld.yes_it_is_free_a7e9: Yes, it is free, and there is no paid version. Every feature works for everyone, with no TMPlayer account, no subscription and no trial. The code is open source under the GPL-3.0, so anyone can read it and build it. There are no ads of its own; Telegram's sponsored messages still appear in public channels, as Telegram requires. The project is paid for by people who choose to: GitHub Sponsors and Buy Me a Coffee take any amount and unlock nothing.
ld.is_tmplayer_safe_can_c92b: Is TMPlayer safe? Can it read my messages?
ld.is_it_the_same_2bed: Is it the same as the official Telegram app?
ld.no_the_official_telegram_cc99: No. The official Telegram apps are messengers made by Telegram for phones and computers, and Telegram has no app for televisions. TMPlayer is an unofficial, independent player: it signs in to the same Telegram account through Telegram's own library and shows only the videos in your chats, laid out for a TV remote, a phone or a desktop window. It cannot send messages, make calls or change your account, so keep the official app for those. Both can be signed in to the same account at the same time.
ld.do_i_need_a_0351: Do I need a phone to sign in?
ld.not_always_you_need_579a: Not always. You need your Telegram account and one of two ways in. The QR code, which a TV and a computer show first: in Telegram on your phone, open Settings, Devices, Link Desktop Device and scan it. Or Log in by phone number, which a phone shows first and a TV and a computer offer as the second choice: enter your number, then the code Telegram sends, usually to Telegram on a device that is already signed in, such as a computer, otherwise by text message or a call. If two-step verification is on, your Telegram password comes next.
ld.does_it_play_music_a59f: Does it play music and audio files?
ld.can_i_use_an_83a7: Can I use an external player for Telegram videos, such as VLC?
ld.yes_tmplayer_is_itself_0c29: Yes. TMPlayer is itself an external player for the videos in your Telegram chats: it signs in to your own account and plays them with their subtitles and every audio track, and remembers where you stopped, so there is no file to save and open elsewhere. On Android it can also pass a video on: the player's menu has Open in another app, which hands it to VLC, MX Player or any other player on the device. A finished download goes over whole, one still downloading goes over as far as it has got, and videos from chats that do not allow saving stay in TMPlayer. The desktop app plays them itself, through mpv, and can also open a downloaded video in the computer's default player.
ld.can_i_download_telegram_2c9f: Can I download Telegram on my TV?
ld.telegram_makes_no_app_f882: Telegram makes no app for televisions. Its Android phone app can be installed on an Android TV by hand, but it is laid out for touch and hard to use with a remote. TMPlayer is made for the TV: on an Android TV, Google TV or Fire TV it signs in to your own Telegram account with a QR code and plays the videos in your chats, without the messages. Samsung TVs on Tizen, LG TVs on webOS, Roku and Apple TV cannot install it, because they do not run Android; plug an Android TV stick or a Fire TV Stick into the TV's HDMI port, or, on a Samsung or LG TV from 2020 or later, open TMPlayer's web app in the TV's browser (a beta).
ld.yes_a_chat_with_48f9: Yes. A chat with music, audio files or voice messages has an Audio list beside its videos, on a phone, a TV and a computer: Play all starts from the oldest, or pick one, and each goes on to the next one posted. On a phone it keeps playing with the screen off. An audio file sent as a plain document, such as an MP3 attached as a file, is not listed yet. The sound inside a video plays too: AAC, MP3, Opus, FLAC, Dolby Digital, DTS, TrueHD and the rest, and a video with several audio tracks lets you switch between them during playback.
ld.it_talks_to_telegram_6ede: It talks to Telegram directly through TDLib, Telegram's official client library, with no TMPlayer server or bot in between. The sign-in shows up in Telegram's list of devices, where you can end it at any time. It only ever shows the videos in your chats: you cannot read, reply or send anything from it. There is no analytics or advertising library, and a crash report goes out only if you agree to send it. All of the code is public under the GPL-3.0, every release is built by GitHub from that code, and the security page shows how to check the file you downloaded.
ld.can_i_cast_telegram_3b85: Can I cast Telegram videos to a Chromecast or Google TV?
ld.yes_from_tmplayer_on_fcf1: Yes, from TMPlayer on an Android phone or on a computer. Press the Cast button in the player, pick the TV on the same Wi-Fi, and the video plays on the TV while your phone or computer keeps the controls: pause, seek, audio tracks, subtitles and the TV's volume. TMPlayer sends the video from Telegram to the TV itself, so MKV videos play, and on a phone a soundtrack the TV cannot play is converted on the way. When you stop, your place is kept for Continue watching. It works with a Chromecast, a Chromecast with Google TV and televisions with Google Cast built in; AirPlay to an Apple TV is not supported. On an Android TV or Google TV you can also install TMPlayer on the TV itself, which leaves the phone free.
ld.no_tmp_telegram_media_35b6: No. TMP - Telegram Media Player is an older app from another developer. When checked on 19 October 2026, its Google Play page was not found, and its Amazon Appstore listing was version 10.0.25, dated December 2021. TMPlayer is a separate, open source app with its own code, made by dracu-lah, and its downloads come only from this site and its GitHub releases. Several apps call themselves a Telegram media player, so check the developer before you install one.

formats.on_android_tv_and_phones: On Android TV and phones, TMPlayer plays through Media3 with FFmpeg decoders built in. On Windows, macOS and Linux it plays through mpv, which opens nearly anything.

formats.anything_telegram_sent_as_a: Anything Telegram sent as a video, whatever the format.
formats.films_are_often_sent_as: Long videos are often sent as files to keep their quality and audio tracks. They show up when Telegram calls them video, or when the name ends in MKV, MP4, M4V, AVI, MOV, WebM, TS, M2TS, MTS, FLV, WMV, MPG, MPEG, 3GP, OGV, DivX, VOB, ASF or RMVB.
formats.the_short_looping_videos_telegram: The short looping videos Telegram calls GIFs, which are really MP4 files.
formats.the_device_s_own_decoders: The device's own decoders come first, because they are the fastest. FFmpeg decoders inside the app take over for what the device has no chip for, which is most often DTS and TrueHD audio.
formats.mkv_webm_mp4_m4v_mov: MKV, WebM, MP4, M4V, MOV, TS, M2TS, MTS, AVI, FLV, MPG, MPEG, 3GP. VOB and DivX files usually play too.
formats.video_h_264_hevc_h: Video: H.264, HEVC (H.265), VP9, VP8, MPEG-2
formats.yes_in_hardware_where_the: Yes. In hardware where the device can, in software through FFmpeg where it cannot. Software decoding is slower, so a 4K file wants a device that decodes it in hardware.
formats.video_av1_mpeg_4_part: Video: AV1, MPEG-4 Part 2 (Xvid, DivX), VC-1, Motion JPEG
formats.through_the_device_s_own: Through the device's own decoder, or the app's own where the device has none. If one decoder fails at the start, the other takes over by itself. Newer TVs and phones handle AV1 well; older sticks may not.
formats.audio_aac_mp3_opus_vorbis: Audio: AAC, MP3, Opus, Vorbis, FLAC, ALAC, PCM
formats.audio_dolby_digital_dolby_digital: Audio: Dolby Digital, Dolby Digital Plus (E-AC-3, Atmos included), DTS, DTS-HD, TrueHD
formats.sent_as_it_is_to: Sent as it is to a soundbar or receiver that takes it, otherwise decoded in the app. {em1} in Settings folds surround into two speakers.
formats.yes_switched_during_playback_and: Yes, switched during playback, and remembered for the rest of a series.
formats.srt_ass_and_ssa_with: SRT, ASS and SSA (with simplified styling), WebVTT, and image subtitles such as PGS and VobSub.
formats.handed_to_the_device_s: Handed to the device's decoder and screen, so it shows in HDR where both support it. Dolby Vision plays as its HDR10 picture on a screen without Dolby Vision, and on a Fire TV Stick 4K a Dolby Vision video that also carries HDR10+ plays instead of a black screen.
formats.on_android_tv_12_and: On Android TV 12 and later with {em1} set to {em2}, the screen switches to the video's own rate, so 24 fps plays at 24 Hz. Elsewhere it switches only when that needs no blank screen.
formats.wmv_and_asf_realmedia_rmvb: {strong1} WMV and ASF, RealMedia (RMVB) and Ogg video (OGV). They still show up in the chat. When one will not play, the player offers {em1}, which hands the downloaded file to a player such as VLC or MX Player.

formats.every_one_in_the_list: Every one in the list above, WMV, ASF, RMVB and OGV included.
formats.h_264_hevc_vp9_av1: H.264, HEVC, VP9, AV1, MPEG-2, MPEG-4 Part 2 and the older formats mpv reads. Hardware decoding where it is safe, with {em1} in Settings for a driver that misbehaves.
formats.aac_mp3_opus_vorbis_flac: AAC, MP3, Opus, Vorbis, FLAC, Dolby Digital and Digital Plus, DTS, DTS-HD and TrueHD.
formats.text_and_image_subtitles_alike: Text and image subtitles alike, ASS with its full styling.
formats.yes_from_the_right_click: Yes, from the right click menu or the keyboard.
formats.for_a_video_whose_subtitles: For a video whose subtitles are not inside it.

guide_cast.title: Cast Telegram videos to a Chromecast or Google TV | TMPlayer
guide_cast.social_title: Cast Telegram videos to a Chromecast or Google TV
guide_cast.description: Cast the videos in your Telegram chats to a Chromecast or Google TV from TMPlayer on a phone or computer, and how Telegram's own Android app compares.
guide_cast.lede: TMPlayer on an Android phone or on a computer casts the videos in your Telegram chats to a Chromecast, a Google TV or a TV with Google Cast built in. The TV plays the video, and your phone or computer keeps the controls.
guide_cast.need_1: TMPlayer 1.27.0 or newer on an Android phone, or on Windows, macOS or Linux
guide_cast.need_2: A Chromecast, a Google TV or Android TV, or a TV with Google Cast built in
guide_cast.need_3: The phone or computer and the TV on the same Wi-Fi
guide_cast.not_2: To download the whole video first
guide_cast.not_3: A bot or a server: the video goes from Telegram through your own phone or computer to the TV
guide_cast.steps_sub: The first time takes a minute. After that it is one press and a pick.
guide_cast.step_1_p: Put the phone or computer on the same Wi-Fi as the Chromecast or the TV. TMPlayer finds the receivers on the network by itself.
guide_cast.step_2_p: Open a video in TMPlayer and press the Cast button: in the player's top bar on a phone, on the player bar on a computer.
guide_cast.step_3_p: Choose the TV from the list. It says it is connecting until the TV is ready, then the video starts there.
guide_cast.step_4_p: Play, pause, seek, skip, switch audio tracks and subtitles and set the TV's volume from the phone or computer. When you stop casting, your place is kept for Continue watching.
guide_cast.handles_h: What does TMPlayer handle when casting?
guide_cast.mkv_p: An MKV video goes to the TV as HLS, cut at its own cue points, so the TV knows how long it is, seeks by itself and plays without stalling.
guide_cast.audio_p: Audio tracks switch on the TV. On a phone, a soundtrack the TV cannot play is converted to AAC so it is heard, with your audio and subtitle choices kept.
guide_cast.subs_p: Subtitles show on the TV, and you turn them on or switch them from your phone or computer.
guide_cast.res_p: TMPlayer says so instead of failing. If the TV cannot decode the picture at all, it tells you rather than converting it.
guide_cast.drop_p: The video waits with Reconnect and Play here instead of starting on the phone, and a short pause from Telegram is retried.
guide_cast.place_p: When you stop casting, the video carries on from where the TV was, and Continue watching keeps it.
guide_cast.limit_airplay: AirPlay to an Apple TV: TMPlayer casts to Google Cast receivers only.
guide_cast.limit_busy: Casting without your device: the phone or computer sends the video, so it stays on the same Wi-Fi with TMPlayer's player open until the video ends.
guide_cast.limit_desktop: Converting a soundtrack on a computer: that is done on a phone only, so from a computer the TV plays the soundtracks it can decode.
guide_cast.telegram_h: Can Telegram's own app cast to a Chromecast?
guide_cast.telegram_p1: Yes, on Android. Telegram added casting to its Android app in March 2025: open a video, tap the Settings icon and pick Chromecast. {a1} names Android only, and it does not say which formats, soundtracks or subtitles the cast handles.
guide_cast.telegram_p2: So for a video Telegram's own player already plays well, its Cast option may be all you need. TMPlayer also casts from a computer, sends MKV as HLS, converts a soundtrack the TV cannot play on a phone, and carries your place over to Continue watching.
guide_cast.caption: Casting Telegram videos: Telegram's Android app and TMPlayer, side by side
guide_cast.tm_from: An Android phone, or a computer with Windows, macOS or Linux
guide_cast.tm_to: A Chromecast, a Google TV, or a TV with Google Cast built in
guide_cast.tg_how: Open a video, tap the Settings icon, pick Chromecast
guide_cast.tm_how: Press Cast in the player and pick the TV
guide_cast.tm_handles: MKV as HLS, audio tracks switched on the TV, a soundtrack the TV cannot play converted on a phone, subtitles shown
guide_cast.table_note: Telegram's column is from {a1} of 7 March 2025; TMPlayer's from its release notes for {a2} and {a3}.
guide_cast.tv_h: When is a player on the TV itself better?
guide_cast.tv_p1: When the TV is an Android TV, a Google TV or a Fire TV, installing TMPlayer on it is usually better than casting: the TV fetches the video from Telegram itself, you use the TV's remote, and the phone is free the moment you have scanned the QR code.
guide_cast.tv_p2: Casting is the better route when the TV takes Google Cast but cannot install apps, when you are at someone else's TV, or for one video now without installing anything.

guide_cast.shot_desktop: {b1} While casting, the player's bar, keys and menus drive the TV.

guide_smart_tv.title: Telegram on a Samsung or LG TV: what works | TMPlayer
guide_smart_tv.social_title: Telegram on a Samsung or LG TV: what works
guide_smart_tv.description: Samsung and LG TVs cannot install Android apps, but TMPlayer opens in their browser as a beta. That, a TV stick, casting, mirroring and Telegram Web, compared.
guide_smart_tv.lede: Samsung TVs run Tizen and LG TVs run webOS. Neither installs Android apps, so Telegram has no app for them and TMPlayer's Android app does not install either. TMPlayer's web app does open in their browser, as a beta. These are the ways that work.
guide_smart_tv.install_h: Can I install Telegram on a Samsung or LG TV?
guide_smart_tv.install_p1: No. Telegram makes apps for Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS and Linux, and a web version, but none for Tizen or webOS, and the TVs' app stores do not take Android apps or APK files. TMPlayer's Android app cannot go on them either, but its web app opens in the TV's browser.
guide_smart_tv.install_p2: What a Samsung or LG TV does have is an HDMI port, and on newer models Google Cast. Either one is enough to get the videos in your chats onto it.
guide_smart_tv.app_h: Can TMPlayer run on a Samsung or LG TV?
guide_smart_tv.app_p1: Yes, as a beta. Open the TV's web browser and go to web.tmplayer.org. The page sees that it is on a Samsung or LG TV and opens TMPlayer's TV version, moved with the remote's arrows, and you sign in by scanning a QR code with Telegram on your phone.
guide_smart_tv.app_p2: It needs a Samsung TV from 2020 or later, or an LG TV on webOS 5 or newer (2020 and later). It is new and has not been tried on every model, and it plays only what the TV's browser can decode, so some videos do not play.
guide_smart_tv.app_p3: For people who already develop for these TVs, each release also carries a package that opens the same page from the TV's app list: an .ipk for LG, installed in LG's Developer Mode, and a .wgt for Samsung, which has to be signed first with a Samsung certificate made for that TV. Most people should use the browser. The packages are on the {a1}.
guide_smart_tv.options_sub: The most dependable is a TV stick in the HDMI port: the TV gets an app you drive with its remote, and the phone is free. The TV's own browser is the free way, while it is in beta.
guide_smart_tv.way_stick_p: An Android TV or Google TV stick, or a Fire TV Stick, in the TV's HDMI port gives it a system that installs TMPlayer. Sign in with a QR code, and the videos in your chats play with the stick's remote.
guide_smart_tv.way_app_p: Open web.tmplayer.org in the TV's web browser. It sees a Samsung or LG TV and opens a version made for the remote, with sign in by QR code. It plays what the TV's browser can decode.
guide_smart_tv.way_cast_p: TMPlayer on an Android phone or on a computer casts to a TV with Google Cast built in, or to a Chromecast plugged into it. The phone or computer keeps the controls.
guide_smart_tv.way_mirror_p: If the TV accepts screen mirroring, the phone's whole screen appears on it. It works with any app, but the phone stays busy and awake until the video ends.
guide_smart_tv.way_web_h: Telegram Web in the TV's browser
guide_smart_tv.way_web_p: The TV's web browser can open Telegram Web and sign in with a QR code. It is a page made for a mouse, and it plays only the formats the browser can decode.
guide_smart_tv.caption: Five ways to get Telegram videos onto a Samsung or LG TV, side by side
guide_smart_tv.row_stick_needs: A TV stick with Android TV or Google TV on Android 6.0 or newer, or a Fire TV Stick on Fire OS 6 or newer.
guide_smart_tv.row_stick_catch: The stick costs money, and TMPlayer is installed from its APK, not from the stick's app store.
guide_smart_tv.row_app_needs: A Samsung TV from 2020 or later, or an LG TV on webOS 5 or newer.
guide_smart_tv.row_app_catch: A beta, not yet tried on every model, and videos the TV's browser cannot decode do not play.
guide_smart_tv.row_cast_needs: A TV with Google Cast built in, or a Chromecast in its HDMI port, on the same Wi-Fi as the phone or computer.
guide_smart_tv.row_cast_phone: It sends the video and keeps the controls, so it stays on the Wi-Fi with the player open.
guide_smart_tv.row_cast_catch: Many Samsung and LG TVs have no Google Cast, and TMPlayer does not cast over AirPlay.
guide_smart_tv.row_mirror_needs: A TV that accepts screen mirroring, on the same Wi-Fi as the phone.
guide_smart_tv.cast_h: Can I cast Telegram to a Samsung or LG TV?
guide_smart_tv.cast_p: Only to a newer one. Google Cast, the way a phone hands a video to a Chromecast, came to both brands' own TVs only lately:
guide_smart_tv.cast_samsung: {b1} Samsung lists Google Cast in the specifications of its 2026 TVs, and in April 2026 an update to its TV software was bringing it to some older models. Before that it was only on Samsung's TVs for hotels and businesses.
guide_smart_tv.cast_lg: {b1} LG added Google Cast with its 2024 TVs, and updates brought it to its 2023 C3 and G3 OLED TVs and to some of its 2022 OLED TVs.
guide_smart_tv.cast_check: To see whether yours has it, look for Google Cast in the TV's specifications. A TV that has it should appear in TMPlayer's Cast list like any other Google Cast receiver. TMPlayer's casting has been tried on an Android TV stick, not yet on a Samsung or LG set.
guide_smart_tv.cast_none: If your TV has no Google Cast, a Chromecast or a Google TV stick in its HDMI port gives it one.
guide_smart_tv.which_h: Which TVs have Google Cast built in?
guide_smart_tv.which_sub: What the makers' own pages or the press confirm, checked on {date}.
guide_smart_tv.which_google_h: Google TV and Android TV sets
guide_smart_tv.which_google_p: Sony says Google Cast works on its Google TV and Android TV models, not on its other TVs. Google names Hisense, Sony and TCL among its Google TV makers, and Philips lists Chromecast built-in for its Google TV sets.
guide_smart_tv.which_vizio_p: Vizio says its smart TVs have Chromecast built-in.
guide_smart_tv.which_samsung_p: Its 2026 models, and some older ones through an update.
guide_smart_tv.which_lg_p: Its 2024 models, and some 2023 and 2022 OLED TVs through updates.
guide_smart_tv.which_hdmi_p: A Chromecast or a Google TV stick plugged into the HDMI port adds Google Cast to any TV.
guide_smart_tv.mirror_p: For a short clip, yes. For a whole episode it is the weakest way: the phone stays awake on the video from start to finish, calls and notifications show on the TV, and the picture is the phone's screen sent again over Wi-Fi, so it is softer and can stutter. Casting sends the video itself, and the TV plays the file.
guide_smart_tv.web_h: Can I use Telegram Web on a Samsung or LG TV?
guide_smart_tv.web_p: You can open Telegram Web in the TV's browser and sign in by scanning its QR code with Telegram on your phone. It is a page made for a mouse and keyboard, driven with a remote, and videos play only in the formats the TV's browser can decode, which often rules out MKV. TMPlayer's web app, above, is laid out for the remote instead.
guide_smart_tv.pick_stick: {b1} if you want the TV to work on its own: TMPlayer on a stick plays from the remote, with subtitles, audio tracks and the next episode, and the phone is free.
guide_smart_tv.pick_app: {b1} to try TMPlayer for free on a 2020 or newer TV, while it is in beta.
guide_smart_tv.pick_cast: {b1} if your TV has Google Cast, or you already own a Chromecast: nothing to install on the TV.
guide_smart_tv.pick_mirror: {b1} for a quick clip from any app.

tmp.lede: Looking for TMP, the TMP app or the TMP APK for your TV? TMP - Telegram Media Player is an app by the developer T.M.P. tmp.what_h: What TMP - Telegram Media Player is
tmp.what_p1: TMP (package com.tmp.com) signs in to your Telegram account on a TV and lets you browse your chats, groups and channels and play their media with the remote. Its listing says it holds no content of its own and shows only what is in the chats you joined, with items up to 2 GB.
tmp.what_p2: It was first listed on the Amazon Appstore on 25 September 2020, and was on Google Play too. Its Amazon listing says it works with the Fire TV voice remote and with game controllers, in English and Hebrew. A Xataka Android guide of January 2025 still suggested it as the way to see only the media in your chats.
tmp.fact_play: Google Play: its page for com.tmp.com answered "not found" on {date}.
tmp.fact_archive: The last Google Play listing the Wayback Machine kept, from 7 December 2020, showed version 10.0.21, updated on 6 October 2020, with 10,000+ installs.
tmp.fact_amazon: Amazon Appstore: still listed on {date}, as version 10.0.25, rated 2.2 out of 5 from 3,219 ratings.
tmp.fact_latest: The newest version we found is 10.0.25, dated 3 December 2021 on APKPure, whose note reads "Fixed login error UPDATE_APP". We found nothing newer, and we did not test whether it still signs in.
tmp.not_p: TMPlayer is not a new version, a fork or a rename of TMP, and its developer has no connection with T.M.P. It is open source, made by dracu-lah, and its downloads come only from tmplayer.org and its GitHub releases. Two apps with close names are easy to mix up, so check the developer before you install either one.
tmp.open_them: No source code linked from its listings
tmp.updated_them: Version 10.0.25, 3 December 2021 (APKPure); its Google Play page is gone
tmp.store_them: The Amazon Appstore on a Fire TV; for Android TV, only third-party APK sites now
tmp.remote_them: Made for the streamer's remote; its listing says no keyboard or mouse is needed
tmp.tracks_them: Captions: its 2020 release notes list "Fixed Captions". Audio tracks: not stated
tmp.series_them: Not stated; it browses chats and folders
tmp.handoff_them: Its 2020 release notes list a setting to pick the buffer and the player before a video plays
tmp.better_updated_p: TMPlayer's latest release is {version}, from {released}. The newest TMP we found is version 10.0.25, from December 2021.
tmp.fine_older_p: TMP's listings ask for Android 5.0. TMPlayer needs Android 6.0 or newer, or Fire OS 6 on a Fire TV, so only a very old box may run TMP and not TMPlayer.
tmp.fine_amazon_p: On a Fire TV, TMP still installs from the Amazon Appstore. TMPlayer is installed once with the Downloader app, then offers its own updates.
tmp.fine_hebrew_p: TMP's Amazon listing names English and Hebrew. TMPlayer comes in 21 languages, and Hebrew is not one of them yet.
tmp.fine_photos_p: TMP's listing offers the files and photos in your chats as well. TMPlayer lists their videos and audio only.
tmp.step_carry_p: Your chats and their videos are in your Telegram account, not in either app, so they are all there. If you no longer use TMP, remove it, and end its session in Telegram under Settings, Devices.
tmp.faq_same_q: Is TMPlayer the same as TMP - Telegram Media Player?
tmp.faq_same_a: No. TMP - Telegram Media Player is an app by T.M.P, first listed in 2020. TMPlayer is a separate, open source app by dracu-lah, with its own code. Neither is made by Telegram.
tmp.faq_apk_q: Where can I download the TMP APK for Android TV?
tmp.faq_apk_a: TMP's Google Play page was not found on {date}, so for an Android TV it is now only on third-party APK sites, which we do not link as downloads. Its Amazon Appstore listing was still up for Fire TV. If what you want is the videos in your Telegram chats on a TV, TMPlayer's own APK is at tmplayer.org/apk, built by GitHub from public code.
tmp.faq_tv_q: Is there a TMP TV app for Fire TV?
tmp.faq_tv_a: Yes: TMP - Telegram Media Player was listed on the Amazon Appstore on {date}, as version 10.0.25. TMPlayer also runs on a Fire TV Stick, Fire TV Cube or Fire TV Edition television with Fire OS 6 or newer, installed with the Downloader app.
tmp.faq_updated_q: Is the TMP app still updated?
tmp.faq_updated_a: The newest version we found is 10.0.25, dated 3 December 2021, and its Google Play page is gone. We did not test whether it still signs in today.
tmp.faq_live_q: Does TMPlayer play TMP live streams or live TV?
tmp.faq_live_a: No. TMPlayer plays the videos already posted in your own Telegram chats and channels. It does not play live TV, Telegram live streams or video chats, and it offers no channels or videos of its own.

tvgramplayer.title: TvGramPlayer vs TMPlayer: Telegram players compared
tvgramplayer.description: TvGramPlayer is a paid Telegram client with a media player and Google Drive. How it compares with TMPlayer, a free, open source Telegram video player.
tvgramplayer.lede: TvGramPlayer is an unofficial Telegram client on Google Play with its own media player. TMPlayer is a free, open source player for the videos in your own Telegram chats. Both sign in to your account; they differ in what they are for, what they cost and where they run.
tvgramplayer.what_p1: TvGramPlayer (com.network.tvgramplayer.playstore), by Lucas Rosillo Fuste, calls itself an unofficial messaging client that uses the Telegram API. Its listing names three things on top of Telegram's own: a built-in player for the media in your chats and channels, a Google Drive connection that plays your Drive files without downloading them first, and a layout for groups, channels and media.
tvgramplayer.what_p2: On {date} it cost $2.49 on Google Play in the United States, with 100+ downloads. It was last updated on 11 October 2026, as version 4.5.85, for Android 5.0 or newer. Its screenshots show a TV layout in Spanish, with playlists and favourites, though the listing does not name the devices it is made for. Its developer declares that it collects and shares no data.
tvgramplayer.name_p: A different app with a close name, Telegram Video Player: TvGram (dev.vishnuv.tvgram, by Small Change Big Difference), is a free Telegram video player for phones, tablets and Android TV, with in-app purchases. On {date} it had 50K+ downloads and was last updated on 5 October 2026. It is not TvGramPlayer, and neither one is connected with TMPlayer.
tvgramplayer.kind_them: A full Telegram client with its own media player
tvgramplayer.platforms_them: Android; its screenshots show a TV layout, and the listing names no device types
tvgramplayer.price_them: $2.49, paid once on Google Play (United States)
tvgramplayer.open_them: No source code linked from its listing
tvgramplayer.messages_them: Yes: chats, groups and channels, as a messaging client
tvgramplayer.drive_them: Yes: plays and shares your Drive files
tvgramplayer.drive_us: No: only the videos in your Telegram chats
tvgramplayer.tracks_them: Not stated; the listing says it supports multiple formats
tvgramplayer.privacy_them: No data collected or shared, as its developer declares on Google Play
tvgramplayer.fine_chat_p: TvGramPlayer is a whole Telegram client, so it reads and sends messages. TMPlayer cannot send anything: keep Telegram, or TvGramPlayer, for that.
tvgramplayer.fine_drive_p: TvGramPlayer plays your Google Drive files as well. TMPlayer plays only what is in your Telegram chats.
tvgramplayer.fine_play_p: It installs and updates from Google Play. TMPlayer is not in the Play Store on a TV: it is installed once from its APK, then offers its own updates.
tvgramplayer.fine_older_p: Its listing asks for Android 5.0. TMPlayer needs Android 6.0 or newer.
tvgramplayer.step_both_p: Telegram lets several apps stay signed in to one account, so TvGramPlayer can stay for messages and Drive while TMPlayer plays the videos. Each one shows in Telegram under Settings, Devices.
tvgramplayer.faq_what_a: An unofficial Telegram client for Android by Lucas Rosillo Fuste, sold on Google Play, with a built-in media player and a Google Drive connection. Its listing says it is not affiliated with Telegram FZ-LLC or Google.
tvgramplayer.faq_free_a: No. On {date} it cost $2.49 on Google Play in the United States, paid once. TMPlayer is free for everyone, with no paid version, no trial and no ads of its own.
tvgramplayer.faq_name_q: Is TvGramPlayer the same as TvGram?
tvgramplayer.faq_name_a: No. TvGramPlayer is by Lucas Rosillo Fuste and costs $2.49. Telegram Video Player: TvGram is a separate, free app by Small Change Big Difference, with in-app purchases. Check the developer's name on the listing before you install either.
tvgramplayer.faq_both_q: Can I use TvGramPlayer and TMPlayer on the same Telegram account?
tvgramplayer.faq_both_a: Yes. Telegram allows several devices and apps signed in at once, and each one appears under Settings, Devices, where you can end it at any time.
tvgramplayer.faq_drive_q: Does TMPlayer play videos from Google Drive?
tvgramplayer.faq_drive_a: No. TMPlayer plays the videos and audio already in your own Telegram chats, saved messages and channels, and nothing from other services.

telegram.title: Telegram on Android TV and Fire TV: the app vs TMPlayer
telegram.description: Is there a Telegram TV app? Telegram on Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV Stick: sideloading, casting and Telegram Web, next to TMPlayer for your videos.
telegram.h1__em1: Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV
telegram.lede: Telegram makes no TV app. You can still get Telegram on Android TV, Google TV or a Fire TV Stick in a few ways: its phone app installed by hand, casting from your phone, or Telegram Web in the TV's browser. Here is what each one gives you, next to TMPlayer, a free player made for the videos in your own Telegram chats.
telegram.what_h: What Telegram itself offers for a TV
telegram.fact_apps: Telegram's apps page lists apps for Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS and Linux, and two web versions. It lists none for televisions.
telegram.fact_play: Google Play on a TV does not offer Telegram, so on an Android TV its APK is installed by hand, as Xataka Android described in January 2025. Telegram publishes that APK itself, on telegram.org/android.
telegram.fact_portrait: Installed that way, the phone app opens in portrait with wide black bars on each side, unless another app forces it into landscape, the same guide found. You sign in with your phone number and the code Telegram sends.
telegram.fact_amazon: A search for Telegram in the Amazon Appstore on {date} listed no app from Telegram itself, so a Fire TV has no Telegram app from Amazon's store.
telegram.fact_cast: Since March 2025, Telegram for Android casts videos to a Chromecast or a TV with Google Cast.
telegram.fact_free: Telegram's apps are free and open source. Telegram Premium lifts download speed limits from your account on Telegram's side.
telegram.ways_h: Three ways, and what each asks of you
telegram.way_sideload_h: The phone app on the TV
telegram.way_sideload_p: Everything Telegram does, on the big screen. It is laid out for a touch screen in portrait, so you steer a phone layout with the remote, and an extra app is needed to turn it sideways.
telegram.way_cast_p: Open the video in Telegram on an Android phone and cast it to a Chromecast or Google TV. The phone stays in charge, and nothing is installed on the TV.
telegram.way_web_h: Telegram Web in the TV's browser
telegram.way_web_p: Telegram Web signs in with a QR code from your phone. It is a page made for a mouse and keyboard, driven with a remote, and it plays only the formats the TV's browser can decode, which often rules out MKV.
telegram.tvapp_us: A TV layout on Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV
telegram.androidtv_them: The phone APK installed by hand; a touch layout in portrait
telegram.androidtv_us: Installed with the Downloader app; made for the remote
telegram.firetv_them: Not in the Amazon Appstore; the phone APK installed by hand
telegram.firetv_us: Fire OS 6 or newer, installed with the Downloader app
telegram.cast_them: From Telegram for Android to a Chromecast, since March 2025
telegram.signin_them: On the TV, your phone number and a code; Telegram Web, a QR code
telegram.series_them: No show pages: videos stay in their chats, in the order they were posted
telegram.desktop_them: Telegram Desktop for Windows, macOS and Linux
telegram.messages_them: Everything: chats, calls, channels and the rest
telegram.price_them: Free; Premium lifts download speed limits
telegram.price_us: Free; Premium lifts the limits on your account here too
telegram.fine_all_p: Messages, calls, stories, bots and the rest stay in Telegram's own apps. TMPlayer only plays, and keeps your phone for the rest.
telegram.fine_cast_p: If you only cast a video now and then from an Android phone, Telegram's own app does it, with nothing more to install.
telegram.fine_official_p: On phones and computers Telegram's apps come from the app stores and from Telegram itself. TMPlayer is unofficial and comes from its own site and GitHub.
telegram.fine_web_p: Telegram Web needs only a browser, which helps on a TV that cannot install Android apps at all.
telegram.step_keep_p: Telegram stays signed in on your phone and computer as before. TMPlayer is one more device on the same account, listed under Settings, Devices, where you can end it at any time.
telegram.faq_app_q: Is there a Telegram TV app?
telegram.faq_app_a: Not from Telegram: its apps page on {date} listed apps for phones, computers and the web, and none for televisions. On an Android TV, Google TV or Fire TV, TMPlayer is a free, unofficial player that signs in to your own account and plays the videos in your chats with the remote.
telegram.faq_download_q: Can I download Telegram on my TV?
telegram.faq_download_a: On an Android TV or Google TV you can install Telegram's Android APK from telegram.org/android by hand, though it is made for a phone screen in portrait. Samsung TVs on Tizen, LG TVs on webOS, Roku and Apple TV cannot install it, because they do not run Android. There, a TV stick is the way in, and on a Samsung or LG TV from 2020 or later TMPlayer's own web app opens in the TV's browser as a beta.
telegram.faq_android_q: How do I get Telegram on Android TV or Google TV?
telegram.faq_android_a: Google Play on a TV does not offer Telegram. Either install its APK by hand, or install TMPlayer with the free Downloader app by typing tmplayer.org/apk, open it and scan its QR code with Telegram on your phone. Your chats and channels then show with their videos as tiles.
telegram.faq_fire_q: Is there Telegram for a Fire TV Stick?
telegram.faq_fire_a: Not in Amazon's store: a search there on {date} showed no app from Telegram. On a Fire TV Stick, Fire TV Cube or Fire TV Edition television with Fire OS 6 or newer, TMPlayer installs with the Downloader app and plays the videos in your chats. Fire TV models that run Vega OS cannot install any APK.
telegram.faq_cast_q: Can I cast Telegram videos to my TV?
telegram.faq_cast_a: Yes. Telegram for Android casts videos to a Chromecast or a TV with Google Cast since March 2025, and TMPlayer casts from a phone or a computer, MKV included, keeping your place for Continue watching.

guide_external.title: External player for Telegram videos, and VLC | TMPlayer
guide_external.social_title: An external player for Telegram videos, and VLC
guide_external.description: TMPlayer is an external player for Telegram videos, with subtitles, audio tracks and resume. On Android it also hands a video to VLC or MX Player.
guide_external.lede: Looking for an external player for Telegram, or a way to play Telegram videos in VLC? TMPlayer is one: a free Telegram video player app that signs in to your own account and plays the videos in your chats, with nothing to save first. On Android it can also pass a video on to VLC, MX Player or any other player.
guide_external.what_sub: On Android TV, Fire TV, Android phones, Windows, Linux and Mac.
guide_external.tracks_p: MKV, MP4, AVI and TS, with embedded subtitles, image-based ones included, and every audio track, switched while the video plays.
guide_external.resume_p: Your place is kept for Continue watching, and a show's episodes are in order on a page of their own.
guide_external.stream_p: A video starts within seconds and keeps downloading while it plays, so there is no file to save and open somewhere else.
guide_external.steps_h: Play a Telegram video in VLC or MX Player
guide_external.steps_sub: On Android: a phone, a tablet, an Android TV or a Fire TV.
guide_external.step_1_p: Install VLC, MX Player or the player you like on the same device, from its store.
guide_external.step_2_p: Open the chat in TMPlayer and start the video.
guide_external.step_3_p: On a phone, tap More options in the player's top bar. On a TV, press Down for the button row and choose More at its end; holding OK while the controls show goes straight to the next step.
guide_external.step_4_p: Pick VLC, MX Player or any other player in the list. TMPlayer saves your place first, so when you come back you carry on from there.
guide_external.gets_whole: A finished download goes over whole.
guide_external.gets_partial: A video still downloading goes over as far as it has got, and TMPlayer warns that the other player will stop there. The download carries on in the background.
guide_external.gets_nothing: A video with nothing on the device yet cannot go over, and TMPlayer says so.
guide_external.gets_protected: A video from a chat that does not allow saving stays in TMPlayer: Open in another app is not in its menu.
guide_external.gets_formats: It is also the way out for the few formats TMPlayer does not play on Android, such as WMV, RealMedia and Ogg video: when one will not play, the player offers Open in another app. {a1}.
guide_external.desktop_p1: On Windows, Linux and Mac, TMPlayer plays every video itself through mpv, with its subtitles, every audio track and keyboard shortcuts.
guide_external.desktop_p2: A video that is downloaded, or already all on the computer, also has Open in another app in its menu. It opens the file in the app the computer uses for that kind of file, such as VLC when VLC is the default. A chat that does not allow saving keeps its videos in TMPlayer here too.
